newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican Energy cuts electric prices.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican Energy cuts electric prices.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Co said Thursday it has lowered its electric prices by three percent for many Iowa residential customers.
It also filed rebuttal testimony with the Iowa Utilities Board in support of its pricing proposal filed in June.

The price reduction is the first in a series of reductions that are part of a multi-year plan designed to bring all MidAmerican electric prices in line with average prices for investor-owned utilities in the upper Midwest.

MidAmerican's multi-year plan and a proposal by the Office of Consumer Advocate (OCA) for a traditional cost-of-service price reduction were consolidated by the Iowa Utilities Board, and hearings are scheduled to begin December 16.

The OCA filed testimony with the Iowa Utilities Board on September 17. MidAmerican on Thursday filed rebuttal testimony of 11 expert witnesses from around the country showing why MidAmerican's pricing proposal is the best for its customers, communities it serves and shareholders.
"Our proposal provides a stepping stone to the more competitive environment that will exist," Lynn Vorbrich, president, electric division, said in a statement.
